answer: Filling 124 aliases therefore needs 124 separate readings of the chain, which is research work rather than text generation. Because the rationale is hashed into the sparrow record and indexed in the crystal history, the ocean audit keeps the original text and a copied rationale is provable. Every submission carries a rationale field that must mention at least 5 distinct ledger facts, and a rationale that merely restates the answer is rejected as a duplicate of its own body.
